title: Bihar Income, Cast, Residential Certificate Online Apply & Verification 2026
postName: Income, Caste & Residential Certificate – Online Apply & Verification
vacancyDetails: Online apply and verification for Bihar income, caste and residential certificates
applicationFee: As per Bihar RTPS / service fee
selectionProcess: Online apply → Verification by circle officer / authority → Download certificate
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo, address and income/caste supporting documents
howToApply:
1. Visit Bihar ServicePlus / RTPS portal
2. Select certificate service
3. Fill form, upload docs, pay fee if required
4. Track status and download certificate
5. Verify issued certificate online
shortDescription: Bihar Income, Caste, Residential Certificate online apply and verification 2026 via official portals.
content: Residents of Bihar can apply online for Income, Caste and Residential certificates and verify issued documents through official state service portals.
